title: FBS Agile Product Manager III- Guidewire
description:
Maximizes the delivery of value to customers in the shortest sustainable lead time. Identifies business and customer needs, prioritizing program level work and guiding this work through the process Program Kanban. Independently develops the vision and roadmap for the value stream in which they support and provides direction and support for other value streams while accomplishing a higher volume of work. Continuously defines, prioritizes, and validates requirements. Leads and collaborates cross\-functionally while leveraging industry, customer, and competitive research, along with data analytics to deliver customer value and to achieve strategic goals and objectives. Provides strategic oversight and leadership to direct reports and is relied upon for strategic leadership within their business unit and across the enterprise.

 **Requirements** **Exp\-** 9 \+ Years

**SKills**\- Guidewire \- Cloud , Rally Microsoft Office Suite , Copilot
  

  

With more enterprise visibility, demonstrates an understanding of the business strategy by developing and maintaining the program vision that defines how their increased size Agile Release Train (ART) will work to achieve the business and enterprise objectives.


Independently responsible for the program roadmap to illustrates how complex features are intended to be implemented over time, delivering on solutions having enterprise scope and/or impact affecting an increased level of stakeholders. In collaboration with System Architect, defines and maintains the Nonfunctional Requirements (NFRs) and other enabler work to ensure the solution meets relevant standards and other system quality requirements.


Works with Epic Owners to develop the Lean business case for Epics that affect one or more ARTs and the enterprise. May participate in Lean Agile Center of Excellence to support relentless improvement and in the extended Lean Portfolio Management activities making funding and priority decisions.


Embraces continuous exploration through frequent customer interaction, user interviews and surveys, and market research; uses findings as input into the strategy, vision, roadmap and selection of features addressing those needs.


Serves as the internal voice of the customer for the ART and works with customers and Product Owners to understand and communicate their needs and participate in the validation of the proposed solutions.


Works closely with development, in short, integrated learning cycles, to bring the voice of the customer to the developers and the voice of development to the customer.


Builds an effective Product Management/Product Owner team to ensure efficient and effective development. Aids in the development of the Product Owners on their train and in the development of other PMs.


Contributes to the job satisfaction that comes with being part of a high\-performing team, one that routinely delivers on its quality and vision commitments.


Responsible for ongoing communication and transparency of the program vision and roadmap. Continuously develops and communicates the vision to the development teams and defines the features of the system.


Provides strategic oversight and leadership to direct reports that may be people leaders in roles such as Product Owners or Analysts.


Heavily supports the department overall for the professional development and management oversight to ensure employee engagement and continual improvement within the team.


Manages the flow of complex work due to large ART size, increased stakeholders and/or internal and external dependencies through the program Kanban. Maintains accountability for content decisions for the ARTs and continuously defines, prioritizes, and validates features.


Embraces changes as indicated by being receptive to emerging knowledge and information that can be quickly fed back into the solution and/or used in prioritization.


Able to make these key decisions independently. Responsible for defining release readiness. Owns the decision of when enough value has been accrued to warrant a release to the customer.


Active participant in biweekly System Demos, including the aggregated System Demo performed end of the Program Increment. Involved in the assessment of Metrics, including evaluation of business value achieved versus plan, and are active, influential participants in the Inspect and Adapt workshop.


During PI planning, responsible for presenting the vision, which highlights the proposed features for the PI, along with any relevant upcoming Milestones. Also act as a Business Owner for the train, with the responsibility of approving PI Objectives and establishing business value. Perform other duties as assigned

title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member III - Guidewire PolicyCenter
description:
Job Summary


This position collaborates with business stakeholders, solution engineers, product owners, and Agile teams to develop, test, and deploy Guidewire PolicyCenter configuration and integration solutions for insurance initiatives. The role applies solid hands\-on knowledge of PolicyCenter configuration, Gosu development, APIs, messaging, batch processing, and cloud delivery practices. It delivers maintainable, secure, production\-ready functionality each sprint with support and limited guidance from senior developers, solution engineers, or architects.


Essential Job Functions

* Codes and configures programs, objects, components, and packaged software to deliver required business functionality.
* Provides technical input into solution design and application functionality, aligning implementation with business needs, coding standards, architectural direction, and Guidewire best practices.
* Reviews and validates code, configuration, and supporting documentation produced by team members.
* Develops maintainable application components with attention to quality, performance, security, reliability, restart and recovery, balancing, controls, and efficient resource utilization.
* Performs broad and detailed impact assessments across people, processes, data, applications, and integrations before implementing changes.
* Analyzes data conversion and data modeling requirements and documents recommended implementation approaches.
* Performs quality checks on code, configuration, related components, test evidence, and documentation; delivers working code incrementally each sprint.
* Executes Test\-Driven Development and Behavior\-Driven Development practices where appropriate to build quality into the solution.
* Supports implementation and release activities, troubleshoots environment and production issues, assists with root cause analysis, and implements corrective actions.
* Uses development automation, test automation results, CI/CD pipelines, source control, and deployment tools to improve delivery quality and efficiency.
* Provides limited technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and mentoring to junior team members when needed.


Guidewire Technical Requirements

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, solution engineering, or a related technology field.
* Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience with Guidewire products, preferably PolicyCenter, including configuration and integration development.
* Experience configuring PolicyCenter product model, business rules, workflows, user interface components, data model extensions, and validation logic using Gosu and Guidewire standards.
* Experience in developing page configuration files, business rules, data model extensions, and unit tests such as GUnit tests.
* Experience in integrating PolicyCenter with portals and enterprise systems using REST services, Guidewire APIs, messaging, events, message queues, plugins, and batch processes.
* Working knowledge of Guidewire Cloud or SaaS delivery practices is preferred, including automated build, test, deployment, and environment support.
* Advanced Product Designer experience is preferred; Jutro Digital Platform exposure is a plus.
* Property and casualty insurance knowledge, including products, coverages, underwriting processes, and integration touchpoints.


Agile Delivery and Collaboration

* Writes and refines user stories with clear technical tasks and accurate acceptance criteria; estimates work using relative sizing and identifies functional design risks.
* Partners with the Product Owner to confirm that implementation and acceptance tests reflect the intended functionality.
* Participates in PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, system demos, retrospectives, and Inspect and Adapt activities.
* Commits to team PI objectives and sprint goals, communicates progress and impediments, and takes ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration, and continuous deployment to support the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and DevOps.
* Demonstrates working functionality to Product and Business Owners and supports iteration and PI System Demos.
* Shares knowledge and best practices, contributes to Communities of Practice, and supports continuous improvement and development of T\-shaped skills.
* Conducts research, design, prototyping, and exploration activities that foster innovation and align delivered solutions with customer needs.

  

**Requirements** **Additional Qualifications**

* Strong verbal, written, listening, and presentation skills, with the ability to adjust technical detail for business and technical audiences.
* Excellent collaboration and team\-building skills, with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders and provide meaningful feedback.
* Demonstrated problem\-solving skills, including the ability to break down moderately complex issues, determine root cause, compare alternatives, and recommend viable solutions.
* Strong ownership and accountability for individual and team deliverables, including timely identification and correction of gaps.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment with ambiguity, changing priorities, and multiple concurrent assignments.
* Working knowledge of software design principles, object\-oriented programming, declarative concepts, defensive coding, error handling, version control, database concepts, SQL, and CI/CD.
* Working\-level understanding of applications within the assigned domain and connected or integrated systems.
* Broad knowledge of insurance concepts, terminology, products, and business processes across relevant business areas.
* Ability to train and mentor others in areas of expertise and provide constructive technical guidance.
* **Education and Certification Requirements**
* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field preferred.
* SAFe Practitioner or SAFe Agilist certification within 180 days of hire required.
* Guidewire Configuration or Integration certification.

  

**Benefits**

**Job Purpose / Overview**


This role exists to provide senior technical project management leadership for the Food \& Nutrition Supply Digital Technology portfolio, ensuring critical Supply DT initiatives are delivered with quality, pace, strong governance and clear business value.


The role will drive the delivery of digital and technology projects across key Supply capabilities, including Thema / Supply Data Foundations, Planning capabilities such as Blue Yonder, and Smart Manufacturing / Industry 4\.0 solutions.


The Senior Technical Project Manager will coordinate business, DT, data, architecture, security, vendor and delivery teams to move initiatives from concept through design, build, testing, deployment, transition and benefit realization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of Supply Digital Technology projects across Food \& Nutrition, covering data foundations, planning, manufacturing and analytics capabilities.
* Manage project delivery across the full lifecycle, including demand shaping, business case support, concept and initiation, design, build, test, deployment, hypercare, project closure and transition to support.
* Drive delivery of Supply DT initiatives such as Thema / Supply Data Foundations, Blue Yonder planning enhancements, and Smart Manufacturing / Industry 4\.0 capabilities, ensuring each initiative has clear scope, milestones, dependencies, risks and success measures.
* Coordinate internal teams, third\-party vendors, system integrators, data partners and business stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within agreed budget and to expected quality standards.
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, RAID logs, dependency maps, governance materials, financial tracking and status reporting for senior DT and business stakeholders.
* Translate business objectives and Supply pain points into actionable delivery plans, working closely with Supply leaders, Business Partners, Product Owners, Data teams, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, GDO and functional SMEs.
* Ensure technical delivery activities are aligned with architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, integration, service introduction and operational support standards.
* Partner with Supply business stakeholders to support business readiness, UAT planning, deployment preparation, adoption tracking and post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Manage delivery risks and issues proactively, escalating where required and driving clear decisions through appropriate governance forums.
* Support vendor and partner management, including input to Statements of Work, delivery plans, resource models, deliverable acceptance and performance management.
* Ensure project documentation is complete, controlled and suitable for transition to support teams, including business process documentation, technical design artefacts, testing evidence, cutover plans and operational handover materials.

* Drive continuous improvement in delivery ways of working, including stronger use of PMX, agile/hybrid delivery methods, lessons learned, reusable templates and project governance discipline.
* Build strong relationships across global and regional Supply teams to ensure delivery plans reflect business priorities, local deployment realities and global template requirements.
* Act as a senior delivery leader within the Supply DT team, providing coaching, structure and delivery discipline to project teams, vendors and junior project resources where required

 **Context and Scope**

  

The role operates within the Food \& Nutrition Supply Digital Technology team, partnering closely with Supply business leaders, regional business partners, functional SMEs, DT delivery teams, Data \& AI, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, GDO, Finance, PMO and external vendors.


The portfolio includes initiatives that enable Supply Chain visibility, planning effectiveness, data\-driven decision making, factory performance improvement and digital adoption across Food \& Nutrition. These include data and analytics foundations through Thema, planning capabilities involving Blue Yonder, and Smart Manufacturing capabilities such as connected worker, factory data, operational visibility and predictive insights.

Required:
